verses.he: בָּעֵ֨ת הַהִ֜וא אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֣ה אֵלַ֗י פְּסָל־לְךָ֞ שְׁנֵֽי־לוּחֹ֤ת אֲבָנִים֙ כָּרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים וַעֲלֵ֥ה אֵלַ֖י הָהָ֑רָה וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לְּךָ֖ אֲרֹ֥ון עֵֽץ׃
verses.ar: «فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْوَقْتِ قَالَ لِيَ ٱلرَّبُّ: ٱنْحَتْ لَكَ لَوْحَيْنِ مِنْ حَجَرٍ مِثْلَ ٱلْأَوَّلَيْنِ، وَٱصْعَدْ إِلَيَّ إِلَى ٱلْجَبَلِ، وَٱصْنَعْ لَكَ تَابُوتًا مِنْ خَشَبٍ.
verses.en: At that time the LORD said unto me: 'Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto Me into the mount; and make thee an ark of wood.
verses.kjv: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
verses.web: At that time Yahweh said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

verses.he: וְאֶכְתֹּב֙ עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֔ת אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֛וּ עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֥ת הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שִׁבַּ֑רְתָּ וְשַׂמְתָּ֖ם בָּאָרֹֽון׃
verses.ar: فَأَكْتُبُ عَلَى ٱللَّوْحَيْنِ ٱلْكَلِمَاتِ ٱلَّتِي كَانَتْ عَلَى ٱللَّوْحَيْنِ ٱلْأَوَّلَيْنِ ٱللَّذَيْنِ كَسَرْتَهُمَا، وَتَضَعُهُمَا فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ.
verses.en: And I will write on the tables the words that were on the first tables which thou didst break, and thou shalt put them in the ark.'
verses.kjv: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
verses.web: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”

verses.he: וָאַ֤עַשׂ אֲרֹון֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וָאֶפְסֹ֛ל שְׁנֵי־לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִ֖ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וָאַ֣עַל הָהָ֔רָה וּשְׁנֵ֥י הַלֻּחֹ֖ת בְּיָדִֽי׃
verses.ar: فَصَنَعْتُ تَابُوتًا مِنْ خَشَبِ ٱلسَّنْطِ، وَنَحَتُّ لَوْحَيْنِ مِنْ حَجَرٍ مِثْلَ ٱلْأَوَّلَيْنِ، وَصَعِدْتُ إِلَى ٱلْجَبَلِ وَٱللَّوْحَانِ فِي يَدِي.
verses.en: So I made an ark of acacia-wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in my hand.
verses.kjv: And I made an ark [of] shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.
verses.web: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

verses.he: וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב עַֽל־הַלֻּחֹ֜ת כַּמִּכְתָּ֣ב הָרִאשֹׁ֗ון אֵ֚ת עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֲלֵיכֶ֥ם בָּהָ֛ר מִתֹּ֥וךְ הָאֵ֖שׁ בְּיֹ֣ום הַקָּהָ֑ל וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָֽי׃
verses.ar: فَكَتَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّوْحَيْنِ مِثْلَ ٱلْكِتَابَةِ ٱلْأُولَى، ٱلْكَلِمَاتِ ٱلْعَشَرَ ٱلَّتِي كَلَّمَكُمْ بِهَا ٱلرَّبُّ فِي ٱلْجَبَلِ مِنْ وَسَطِ ٱلنَّارِ فِي يَوْمِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ، وَأَعْطَانِيَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِيَّاهَا.
verses.en: And He wrote on the tables according to the first writing, the ten words, which the LORD spoke unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them unto me.
verses.kjv: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.
verses.web: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Yahweh spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and Yahweh gave them to me.

verses.he: וָאֵ֗פֶן וָֽאֵרֵד֙ מִן־הָהָ֔ר וָֽאָשִׂם֙ אֶת־הַלֻּחֹ֔ת בָּאָרֹ֖ון אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַיִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖נִי יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ ٱنْصَرَفْتُ وَنَزَلْتُ مِنَ ٱلْجَبَلِ وَوَضَعْتُ ٱللَّوْحَيْنِ فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ ٱلَّذِي صَنَعْتُ، فَكَانَا هُنَاكَ كَمَا أَمَرَنِيَ ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.en: And I turned and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they are, as the LORD commanded me. —
verses.kjv: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.
verses.web: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as Yahweh commanded me.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נָֽסְע֛וּ מִבְּאֵרֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־יַעֲקָ֖ן מֹוסֵרָ֑ה שָׁ֣ם מֵ֤ת אַהֲרֹן֙ וַיִּקָּבֵ֣ר שָׁ֔ם וַיְכַהֵ֛ן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בְּנֹ֖ו תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ ٱرْتَحَلُوا مِنْ آبَارِ بَنِي يَعْقَانَ إِلَى مُوسِيرَ. هُنَاكَ مَاتَ هَارُونُ، وَهُنَاكَ دُفِنَ. فَكَهَنَ أَلِعَازَارُ ٱبْنُهُ عِوَضًا عَنْهُ.
verses.en: And the children of Israel journeyed from Beeroth-benejaakan to Moserah; there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.
verses.web: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.

verses.he: מִשָּׁ֥ם נָסְע֖וּ הַגֻּדְגֹּ֑דָה וּמִן־הַגֻּדְגֹּ֣דָה יָטְבָ֔תָה אֶ֖רֶץ נַֽחֲלֵי מָֽיִם׃
verses.ar: مِنْ هُنَاكَ ٱرْتَحَلُوا إِلَى ٱلْجِدْجُودِ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِدْجُودِ إِلَى يُطْبَاتَ، أَرْضِ أَنْهَارِ مَاءٍ.
verses.en: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgod; and from Gudgod to Jotbah, a land of brooks of water. —
verses.kjv: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.
verses.web: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.

verses.he: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗וא הִבְדִּ֤יל יְהוָה֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣בֶט הַלֵּוִ֔י לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־אֲרֹ֣ון בְּרִית־יְהוָ֑ה לַעֲמֹד֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֤ה לְשָֽׁרְתֹו֙ וּלְבָרֵ֣ךְ בִּשְׁמֹ֔ו עַ֖ד הַיֹּ֥ום הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.ar: فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْوَقْتِ أَفْرَزَ ٱلرَّبُّ سِبْطَ لَاوِي لِيَحْمِلُوا تَابُوتَ عَهْدِ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَلِكَيْ يَقِفُوا أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ لِيَخْدِمُوهُ وَيُبَارِكُوا بِٱسْمِهِ إِلَى هَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ.
verses.en: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto Him, and to bless in His name, unto this day.
verses.kjv: ¶ At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
verses.web: At that time Yahweh set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, to stand before Yahweh to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.

verses.he: עַל־כֵּ֞ן לֹֽא־הָיָ֧ה לְלֵוִ֛י חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה עִם־אֶחָ֑יו יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָתֹ֔ו כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לֹֽו׃
verses.ar: لِأَجْلِ ذَلِكَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِلَاوِي قِسْمٌ وَلَا نَصِيبٌ مَعَ إِخْوَتِهِ. ٱلرَّبُّ هُوَ نَصِيبُهُ كَمَا كَلَّمَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ.
verses.en: Wherefore Levi hath no portion nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God spoke unto him. —
verses.kjv: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD [is] his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.
verses.web: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; Yahweh is his inheritance, according as Yahweh your God spoke to him.)

verses.he: וְאָנֹכִ֞י עָמַ֣דְתִּי בָהָ֗ר כַּיָּמִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אַרְבָּעִ֣ים יֹ֔ום וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֔י גַּ֚ם בַּפַּ֣עַם הַהִ֔וא לֹא־אָבָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה הַשְׁחִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: «وَأَنَا مَكَثْتُ فِي ٱلْجَبَلِ كَٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْأُولَى، أَرْبَعِينَ نَهَارًا وَأَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً. وَسَمِعَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِي تِلْكَ ٱلْمَرَّةَ أَيْضًا، وَلَمْ يَشَإِ ٱلرَّبُّ أَنْ يُهْلِكَكَ.
verses.en: Now I stayed in the mount, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me that time also; the LORD would not destroy thee.
verses.kjv: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also, [and] the LORD would not destroy thee.
verses.web: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and Yahweh listened to me that time also. Yahweh would not destroy you.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י ק֛וּם לֵ֥ךְ לְמַסַּ֖ע לִפְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וְיָבֹ֙אוּ֙ וְיִֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃ פ
verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَالَ لِيَ ٱلرَّبُّ: قُمِ ٱذْهَبْ لِلِٱرْتِحَالِ أَمَامَ ٱلشَّعْبِ، فَيَدْخُلُوا وَيَمْتَلِكُوا ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلَّتِي حَلَفْتُ لِآبَائِهِمْ أَنْ أُعْطِيَهُمْ.
verses.en: And the LORD said unto me: 'Arise, go before the people, causing them to set forward, that they may go in and possess the land, which I swore unto their fathers to give unto them.'
verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take [thy] journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
verses.web: Yahweh said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”

verses.he: וְעַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מָ֚ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ שֹׁאֵ֖ל מֵעִמָּ֑ךְ כִּ֣י אִם־לְ֠יִרְאָה אֶת־יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לָלֶ֤כֶת בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו֙ וּלְאַהֲבָ֣ה אֹתֹ֔ו וְלַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.ar: «فَٱلْآنَ يَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، مَاذَا يَطْلُبُ مِنْكَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَتَّقِيَ ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَكَ لِتَسْلُكَ فِي كُلِّ طُرُقِهِ، وَتُحِبَّهُ، وَتَعْبُدَ ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَكَ مِنْ كُلِّ قَلْبِكَ وَمِنْ كُلِّ نَفْسِكَ،
verses.en: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all His ways, and to love Him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul;
verses.kjv: ¶ And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
verses.web: Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

verses.he: לִשְׁמֹ֞ר אֶת־מִצְוֹ֤ת יְהוָה֙ וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיֹּ֑ום לְטֹ֖וב לָֽךְ׃
verses.ar: وَتَحْفَظَ وَصَايَا ٱلرَّبِّ وَفَرَائِضَهُ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا أُوصِيكَ بِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ لِخَيْرِكَ.
verses.en: to keep for thy good the commandments of the LORD, and His statutes, which I command thee this day?
verses.kjv: To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?
verses.web: to keep Yahweh’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?

verses.he: הֵ֚ן לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּשְׁמֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם הָאָ֖רֶץ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּֽהּ׃
verses.ar: هُوَذَا لِلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ وَسَمَاءُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَكُلُّ مَا فِيهَا.
verses.en: Behold, unto the LORD thy God belongeth the heaven, and the heaven of heavens, the earth, with all that therein is.
verses.kjv: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens [is] the LORD’s thy God, the earth [also], with all that therein [is].
verses.web: Behold, to Yahweh your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.

verses.he: רַ֧ק בַּאֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ חָשַׁ֥ק יְהוָ֖ה לְאַהֲבָ֣ה אֹותָ֑ם וַיִּבְחַ֞ר בְּזַרְעָ֣ם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם בָּכֶ֛ם מִכָּל־הָעַמִּ֖ים כַּיֹּ֥ום הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.ar: وَلَكِنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ إِنَّمَا ٱلْتَصَقَ بِآبَائِكَ لِيُحِبَّهُمْ، فَٱخْتَارَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ نَسْلَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي هُوَ أَنْتُمْ فَوْقَ جَمِيعِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ كَمَا فِي هَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ.
verses.en: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and He chose their seed after them, even you, above all peoples, as it is this day.
verses.kjv: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, [even] you above all people, as [it is] this day.
verses.web: Only Yahweh had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.

verses.he: וּמַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת עָרְלַ֣ת לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְעָ֨רְפְּכֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַקְשׁ֖וּ עֹֽוד׃
verses.ar: فَٱخْتِنُوا غُرْلَةَ قُلُوبِكُمْ، وَلَا تُصَلِّبُوا رِقَابَكُمْ بَعْدُ.
verses.en: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
verses.kjv: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
verses.web: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.

verses.he: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֚וּא אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַאֲדֹנֵ֖י הָאֲדֹנִ֑ים הָאֵ֨ל הַגָּדֹ֤ל הַגִּבֹּר֙ וְהַנֹּורָ֔א אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא־יִשָּׂ֣א פָנִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִקַּ֖ח שֹֽׁחַד׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَكُمْ هُوَ إِلَهُ ٱلْآلِهَةِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْأَرْبَابِ، ٱلْإِلَهُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمَهِيبُ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَأْخُذُ بِٱلْوُجُوهِ وَلَا يَقْبَلُ رَشْوَةً.
verses.en: For the LORD your God, He is God of gods, and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awful, who regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward.
verses.kjv: For the LORD your God [is] God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:
verses.web: For Yahweh your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.

verses.he: עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט יָתֹ֖ום וְאַלְמָנָ֑ה וְאֹהֵ֣ב גֵּ֔ר לָ֥תֶת לֹ֖ו לֶ֥חֶם וְשִׂמְלָֽה׃
verses.ar: ٱلصَّانِعُ حَقَّ ٱلْيَتِيمِ وَٱلْأَرْمَلَةِ، وَٱلْمُحِبُّ ٱلْغَرِيبَ لِيُعْطِيَهُ طَعَامًا وَلِبَاسًا.
verses.en: He doth execute justice for the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
verses.kjv: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
verses.web: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.

verses.he: וַאֲהַבְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־הַגֵּ֑ר כִּֽי־גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.ar: فَأَحِبُّوا ٱلْغَرِيبَ لِأَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ غُرَبَاءَ فِي أَرْضِ مِصْرَ.
verses.en: Love ye therefore the stranger; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.kjv: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.web: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

verses.he: אֶת־יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ תִּירָ֖א אֹתֹ֣ו תַעֲבֹ֑ד וּבֹ֣ו תִדְבָּ֔ק וּבִשְׁמֹ֖ו תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ׃
verses.ar: ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَكَ تَتَّقِي. إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُ، وَبِهِ تَلْتَصِقُ، وَبِٱسْمِهِ تَحْلِفُ.
verses.en: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; Him shalt thou serve; and to Him shalt thou cleave, and by His name shalt thou swear.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.
verses.web: You shall fear Yahweh your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.

verses.he: ה֥וּא תְהִלָּתְךָ֖ וְה֣וּא אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֣ה אִתְּךָ֗ אֶת־הַגְּדֹלֹ֤ת וְאֶת־הַנֹּֽורָאֹת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָא֖וּ עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: هُوَ فَخْرُكَ، وَهُوَ إِلَهُكَ ٱلَّذِي صَنَعَ مَعَكَ تِلْكَ ٱلْعَظَائِمَ وَٱلْمَخَاوِفَ ٱلَّتِي أَبْصَرَتْهَا عَيْنَاكَ.
verses.en: He is thy glory, and He is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and tremendous things, which thine eyes have seen.
verses.kjv: He [is] thy praise, and he [is] thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.
verses.web: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.

verses.he: בְּשִׁבְעִ֣ים נֶ֔פֶשׁ יָרְד֥וּ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ מִצְרָ֑יְמָה וְעַתָּ֗ה שָֽׂמְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כְּכֹוכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹֽב׃
verses.ar: سَبْعِينَ نَفْسًا نَزَلَ آبَاؤُكَ إِلَى مِصْرَ، وَٱلْآنَ قَدْ جَعَلَكَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ كَنُجُومِ ٱلسَّمَاءِ فِي ٱلْكَثْرَةِ.
verses.en: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.kjv: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.web: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now Yahweh your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.
